## CREATING A NULL BY SHUFFLING SAMPLES

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
#ab_null
set.seed(2025)

# Number of permutations
n_perm <- 1000

# Initialize storage
null_summaries <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_perm, ncol = 11) #used 7 col for the original null_summaries
#colnames(null_summaries) <- c("mean", "median", "p80", "p90", "p92.5", "p95", "p97.5")
colnames(null_summaries) <- c("mean", "median", "p80", "p90", "p92.5", "p95", "p97.5","p98.5","p99.5","p99.95","max")
message("Starting null permutation procedure...")
for (i in 1:n_perm) {
  if (i %% 50 == 0) message("Completed ", i, " of ", n_perm, " permutations...")
  
  # Shuffle brain sample columns to break subject alignment
  v_brain_null <- v_brain$E[, sample(ncol(v_brain$E))]

  # Compute Spearman correlation between blood and shuffled brain expression
  null_cor <- cor(t(v_blood$E), t(v_brain_null), method = "spearman")
  abs_cor <- abs(null_cor)
  
  # Store summary statistics
  null_summaries[i, ] <- c(
    mean = mean(abs_cor),
    median = median(abs_cor),
    p80 = quantile(abs_cor, 0.80),
    p90 = quantile(abs_cor, 0.90),
    p92.5 = quantile(abs_cor, 0.925),
    p95 = quantile(abs_cor, 0.95),
    p97.5 = quantile(abs_cor, 0.975),
    p98.5 = quantile(abs_cor, 0.985),
    p99.5 = quantile(abs_cor, 0.995),
    p99.95 = quantile(abs_cor, 0.9995),
    max = max(abs_cor)
  )
}
null_summaries_df <- as.data.frame(null_summaries)
write.table(null_summaries_df, file = "/sc/arion/projects/mscic1/results/jolie/LBP/blood-brain/qc2/null_summaries2.txt", sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
message("Permutation complete. Next step: compute empirical p-values.")

##this has the original null summaries, colnames(null_summaries) <- c("mean", "median", "p80", "p90", "p92.5", "p95", "p97.5")

  correlation = blood_form3_by_brain_cor[high_corr_indices]
)
```

## ONE COVAR AT A TIME

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
library(variancePartition)
library(data.table)

blood_expr <- v_blood$E
brain_expr <- t(v_brain$E)

# Try all covariates in blood_only_metadata
covariate_list <- colnames(blood_only_metadata)

# Store summary stats and log skipped covariates
all_summary_stats <- list()
skipped_covariates <- c()

for (covariate in covariate_list) {
  message("Processing covariate: ", covariate)
  
  # Fixed-effect formula
  form <- as.formula(paste("~", covariate))
  
  # Fit model with tryCatch to handle errors
  result <- tryCatch({
    fit <- dream(blood_expr, form, blood_only_metadata)
    resid_expr <- residuals(fit)
    
    # Save residualized matrix
    resid_file <- paste0("/sc/arion/projects/mscic1/results/jolie/LBP/blood-brain/resid_expr_blood_form_", covariate, ".txt")
    write.table(resid_expr, file = resid_file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, col.names = NA)
    
    # Correlation
    blood_resid_t <- t(resid_expr)
    cor_matrix <- abs(cor(blood_resid_t, brain_expr, method = "spearman"))
    
    # Save correlation matrix
    cor_file <- paste0("/sc/arion/projects/mscic1/results/jolie/LBP/blood-brain/cor_matrix_blood_form_", covariate, ".txt")
    write.table(cor_matrix, file = cor_file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = TRUE, col.names = NA)
    
    # Summary stats
    cor_vals <- as.vector(cor_matrix)
    stats <- data.frame(
      covariate = covariate,
      mean = mean(cor_vals),
      median = median(cor_vals),
      q80 = quantile(cor_vals, 0.80),
      q90 = quantile(cor_vals, 0.90),
      q92.5 = quantile(cor_vals, 0.925),
      q95 = quantile(cor_vals, 0.95),
      q97.5 = quantile(cor_vals, 0.975),
      q99.5 = quantile(cor_vals, 0.995),
      q99.95 = quantile(cor_vals, 0.9995),
      max = max(cor_vals)
    )
    
    all_summary_stats[[covariate]] <- stats
    NULL  # return NULL on success
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Skipping ", covariate, ": ", e$message)
    skipped_covariates <<- c(skipped_covariates, covariate)
    NULL
  })
}

# Combine summary stats and save
summary_df <- do.call(rbind, all_summary_stats)
summary_file <- "/sc/arion/projects/mscic1/results/jolie/LBP/blood-brain/correlation_summary_stats_by_covariate.txt"
write.table(summary_df, file = summary_file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

# Optionally report skipped variables
if (length(skipped_covariates) > 0) {
  message("Skipped ", length(skipped_covariates), " covariates due to errors.")
  print(skipped_covariates)
}
```

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
## Create a R script with the following: 
library(data.table)
library(readxl)
library(edgeR)
library(limma)
library(matrixStats)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(variancePartition)
library(BiocParallel)

# Load voom expression and metadata
load("/sc/arion/projects/mscic1/results/jolie/LBP/blood-brain/blood-brain_sample_baseline_with_voom_20250522.RData")

# Set output directory
output_dir <- "/sc/arion/projects/mscic1/results/jolie/LBP/blood-brain/qc"

# Remove outlier samples
blood_samples_to_be_removed <- c("LBPSEMA4BLOOD795", "LBPSEMA4BLOOD142", "LBPSEMA4BLOOD049", "LBPSEMA4BLOOD755",
                                  "LBPSEMA4BLOOD335","LBPSEMA4BLOOD431","LBPSEMA4BLOOD174","LBPSEMA4BLOOD738")

v_blood$E <- v_blood$E[, !colnames(v_blood$E) %in% blood_samples_to_be_removed]
blood_metadata <- blood_metadata[!rownames(blood_metadata) %in% blood_samples_to_be_removed, ]

# Subset blood-only covariates and align
blood_only_metadata <- blood_metadata[, grepl("_blood$", names(blood_metadata))]
blood_only_metadata <- blood_only_metadata[!rownames(blood_only_metadata) %in% blood_samples_to_be_removed, ]
blood_only_metadata <- blood_only_metadata[colnames(v_blood$E), ]  # Ensure alignment

# Step 1: Filter well-behaved numeric covariates
is_valid_numeric <- function(x) {
  is.numeric(x) && var(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 1e-6 && mean(!is.na(x)) > 0.9
}
valid_covariates <- names(Filter(is_valid_numeric, blood_only_metadata))

# Step 2: Remove globally highly correlated covariates
cor_mat <- cor(blood_only_metadata[, valid_covariates], use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
high_cor_idx <- findCorrelation(cor_mat, cutoff = 0.9)
valid_covariates <- valid_covariates[-high_cor_idx]
message("Number of valid, non-collinear covariates: ", length(valid_covariates))

# Step 3: Create all pairwise combos and filter those with high correlation
combos_raw <- combn(valid_covariates, 2, simplify = FALSE)

# Filter combos based on pairwise correlation and constant columns
combos_filtered <- list()
correlation_log <- data.frame(
  Covariate1 = character(),
  Covariate2 = character(),
  Correlation = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (combo in combos_raw) {
  dat <- blood_only_metadata[, combo]
  if (any(apply(dat, 2, function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) < 1e-6))) next
  cor_val <- cor(dat[[1]], dat[[2]], use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  if (abs(cor_val) > 0.99) next
  combos_filtered[[length(combos_filtered) + 1]] <- combo
  correlation_log <- rbind(
    correlation_log,
    data.frame(Covariate1 = combo[1], Covariate2 = combo[2], Correlation = cor_val)
  )
}

set.seed(2025)
combos_all <- sample(combos_filtered)
message("Number of combos after filtering: ", length(combos_all))

# Step 4: Safe model fitting function
safe_fit_model <- function(covs, expr, metadata) {
  tryCatch({
    form_str <- paste("~", paste(covs, collapse = " + "))
    form <- as.formula(form_str)
    fit <- dream(expr, form, metadata)
    resid_expr <- residuals(fit)
    if (!is.matrix(resid_expr) || ncol(resid_expr) != ncol(expr)) {
      message("Invalid residual dimensions for combo: ", paste(covs, collapse = ", "))
      return(NULL)
    }
    list(resid = resid_expr, formula = form_str, covariates = covs)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Error for combo: ", paste(covs, collapse = ", "), " -> ", e$message)
    return(NULL)
  })
}

# Step 5: Run and save up to 100 successful combinations
successful_combos <- list()
max_needed <- 100

for (i in seq_along(combos_all)) {
  combo <- combos_all[[i]]
  message("Trying combo #", i, ": ", paste(combo, collapse = ", "))

  fit_result <- safe_fit_model(combo, v_blood$E, blood_only_metadata)

  if (!is.null(fit_result)) {
    combo_num <- length(successful_combos) + 1

    # Save residuals
    resid_path <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("resid_expr_blood_k2_combo", combo_num, ".txt"))
    write.table(fit_result$resid, file = resid_path, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, col.names = NA)

    # Save formula and covariates
    model_info <- list(formula = fit_result$formula, covariates = fit_result$covariates)
    saveRDS(model_info, file = file.path(output_dir, paste0("model_form_k2_combo", combo_num, ".rds")))

    successful_combos[[combo_num]] <- model_info
    message("Saved combo #", combo_num, ": ", paste(combo, collapse = ", "))
  }

  if (length(successful_combos) == max_needed) {
    message("Reached 100 valid combos.")
    break
  }
}
# Step 6: Save pairwise correlation log
write.csv(correlation_log, file = file.path(output_dir, "pairwise_covariate_correlations.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## QC Permutation Result Extraction -- 400 blood GE matrices 
k= 2 : 5 with combo 1 : 100

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
## Create a R script with the following: 
screen -r random_covar_cor_qc #in cbipm01-1s

library(data.table)
library(readxl)
library(edgeR)
library(limma)
library(matrixStats)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(variancePartition)
library(BiocParallel)
library(caret)
setwd("/sc/arion/projects/mscic1/results/jolie/LBP/blood-brain/qc")

# Set input/output paths
input_dir <- "/sc/arion/projects/mscic1/results/jolie/LBP/blood-brain/qc"
output_dir <- "/sc/arion/projects/mscic1/results/jolie/LBP/blood-brain/qc"

# Transpose brain expression once outside the loop for efficiency
brain_expr <- t(v_brain$E)

# Initialize a list to hold summary stats for each k
all_summary_stats <- list()

# for (k in 2:5) {
# for (k in 6) {
for (k in 6) {
  message("Starting k = ", k)  # Show progress
  
  # Initialize a data frame to hold summary stats for this k
  summary_stats_k <- data.frame(
    k = integer(),
    combo = integer(),
    mean = numeric(),
    median = numeric(),
    q80 = numeric(),
    q90 = numeric(),
    q92.5 = numeric(),
    q95 = numeric(),
    q97.5 = numeric(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Loop over combo = 1 to 100 for each k
  for (combo in 1:100) {
    message(sprintf("Processing k = %d, combo = %d", k, combo))
    
    # Construct file path and load blood expression matrix
    file_name <- sprintf("resid_expr_blood_k%d_combo%d.txt", k, combo)
    file_path <- file.path(input_dir, file_name)
    blood_expr <- fread(file_path, data.table = FALSE)
    
    # Set row names and remove first column
    rownames(blood_expr) <- blood_expr$V1
    blood_expr$V1 <- NULL
    
    # Transpose blood expression so samples are rows
    blood_expr <- t(blood_expr)
    
    # Compute absolute Spearman correlation between blood and brain
    cor_matrix <- abs(cor(blood_expr, brain_expr, method = "spearman"))
    
    # Save correlation matrix to file
    cor_outfile <- sprintf("blood_k%d_combo%d_brain_baseline_spearman_cor_matrix.txt", k, combo)
    write.table(
      cor_matrix,
      file = file.path(output_dir, cor_outfile),
      sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = TRUE, col.names = NA
    )
    
    # Flatten correlation values and compute summary statistics
    cor_vals <- as.vector(cor_matrix)
    stats <- c(
      mean = mean(cor_vals),
      median = median(cor_vals),
      q80 = quantile(cor_vals, 0.80),
      q90 = quantile(cor_vals, 0.90),
      q92.5 = quantile(cor_vals, 0.925),
      q95 = quantile(cor_vals, 0.95),
      q97.5 = quantile(cor_vals, 0.975),
      q99.5 = quantile(cor_vals, 0.995), #new
      q99.95 = quantile(cor_vals, 0.9995), #new
      max = max(cor_vals) #new
    )
    
    # Add results to summary data frame
    summary_stats_k <- rbind(summary_stats_k, data.frame(k = k, combo = combo, t(stats)))
  }
  
  # Save summary statistics for this k
  all_summary_stats[[paste0("k", k)]] <- summary_stats_k
  write.table(
    summary_stats_k,
    file = file.path(output_dir, sprintf("summary_stats_k%d.txt", k)), #this contains the original mean, median, p80, p90, ..., p97.5
    sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  message("Finished k = ", k)
}
```

## Permutations of Covariates Selections 
k=3 : 5
```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
## Create a R script with the following: 
library(data.table)
library(readxl)
library(edgeR)
library(limma)
library(matrixStats)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(variancePartition)
library(BiocParallel)
library(caret)

# Load voom expression and metadata
load("/sc/arion/projects/mscic1/results/jolie/LBP/blood-brain/blood-brain_sample_baseline_with_voom_20250522.RData")

# Set output directory
output_dir <- "/sc/arion/projects/mscic1/results/jolie/LBP/blood-brain/qc"

# Remove outlier samples
blood_samples_to_be_removed <- c("LBPSEMA4BLOOD795", "LBPSEMA4BLOOD142", "LBPSEMA4BLOOD049", "LBPSEMA4BLOOD755",
                                  "LBPSEMA4BLOOD335","LBPSEMA4BLOOD431","LBPSEMA4BLOOD174","LBPSEMA4BLOOD738")

v_blood$E <- v_blood$E[, !colnames(v_blood$E) %in% blood_samples_to_be_removed]
blood_metadata <- blood_metadata[!rownames(blood_metadata) %in% blood_samples_to_be_removed, ]

# Subset blood-only covariates and align
blood_only_metadata <- blood_metadata[, grepl("_blood$", names(blood_metadata))]
blood_only_metadata <- blood_only_metadata[!rownames(blood_only_metadata) %in% blood_samples_to_be_removed, ]
blood_only_metadata <- blood_only_metadata[colnames(v_blood$E), ]  # Ensure alignment

# Step 1: Filter well-behaved numeric covariates
is_valid_numeric <- function(x) {
  is.numeric(x) && var(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 1e-6 && mean(!is.na(x)) > 0.9
}
valid_covariates <- names(Filter(is_valid_numeric, blood_only_metadata))

# Step 2: Remove globally highly correlated covariates
cor_mat <- cor(blood_only_metadata[, valid_covariates], use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
high_cor_idx <- findCorrelation(cor_mat, cutoff = 0.9)
valid_covariates <- valid_covariates[-high_cor_idx]
message("Number of valid, non-collinear covariates: ", length(valid_covariates))

# Set k = 3 for triplet combinations
# Set k = 4 for quadruplets combinations
k <- 6
combos_raw <- combn(valid_covariates, k, simplify = FALSE)
n_combos <- length(combos_raw)

# Preallocate storage
combos_filtered <- vector("list", n_combos)
correlation_records <- vector("list", n_combos)

message("Total 6-covariate combos to evaluate: ", n_combos)
#message("Total 5-covariate combos to evaluate: ", n_combos)
#message("Total 4-covariate combos to evaluate: ", n_combos)
#message("Total 3-covariate combos to evaluate: ", n_combos)

for (i in seq_len(n_combos)) {
  combo <- combos_raw[[i]]
  if (i %% 500 == 0) message("Processing combo #", i, " of ", n_combos)

  dat <- blood_only_metadata[, combo]

  # Skip if any covariate is constant
  if (any(apply(dat, 2, function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) < 1e-6))) next

  # Check all 3 pairwise correlations in this combo
  pairs <- combn(combo, 2, simplify = FALSE)
  cor_vals <- sapply(pairs, function(p) cor(dat[[p[1]]], dat[[p[2]]], use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))

  # Skip if any correlation is too high
  if (any(abs(cor_vals) > 0.99)) next

  # Store valid combo
  combos_filtered[[i]] <- combo

  # Log correlations
  correlation_records[[i]] <- data.frame(
    Combo_ID = i,
    Full_Combo = paste(combo, collapse = " + "),
    Covariate1 = sapply(pairs, `[[`, 1),
    Covariate2 = sapply(pairs, `[[`, 2),
    Correlation = cor_vals,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# Finalize output
combos_all <- combos_filtered[!sapply(combos_filtered, is.null)]
correlation_log <- rbindlist(correlation_records[!sapply(correlation_records, is.null)])

message("Number of valid 6-covariate combos after filtering: ", length(combos_all))

#message("Number of valid 5-covariate combos after filtering: ", length(combos_all))
#message("Number of valid 4-covariate combos after filtering: ", length(combos_all))
#message("Number of valid 3-covariate combos after filtering: ", length(combos_all))

set.seed(2025)
combos_all2 <- sample(combos_all)
message("Number of combos after filtering: ", length(combos_all2)) 

## 3-covariate combos: before 300k after 278365
## 4-covariate combos: before 9078630 after 7726302
## 5-covariate combos: before 2349060 after 


# Step 4: Safe model fitting function
safe_fit_model <- function(covs, expr, metadata) {
  tryCatch({
    form_str <- paste("~", paste(covs, collapse = " + "))
    form <- as.formula(form_str)
    fit <- dream(expr, form, metadata)
    resid_expr <- residuals(fit)
    if (!is.matrix(resid_expr) || ncol(resid_expr) != ncol(expr)) {
      message("Invalid residual dimensions for combo: ", paste(covs, collapse = ", "))
      return(NULL)
    }
    list(resid = resid_expr, formula = form_str, covariates = covs)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Error for combo: ", paste(covs, collapse = ", "), " -> ", e$message)
    return(NULL)
  })
}

# Step 5: Run and save up to 100 successful combinations
successful_combos <- list()
max_needed <- 100

for (i in seq_along(combos_all2)) {
  combo <- combos_all2[[i]]
  message("Trying combo #", i, ": ", paste(combo, collapse = ", "))

  fit_result <- safe_fit_model(combo, v_blood$E, blood_only_metadata)

  if (!is.null(fit_result)) {
    combo_num <- length(successful_combos) + 1

    # Save residuals
    resid_path <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("resid_expr_blood_k6_combo", combo_num, ".txt"))
    write.table(fit_result$resid, file = resid_path, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, col.names = NA)

    # Save formula and covariates
    model_info <- list(formula = fit_result$formula, covariates = fit_result$covariates)
    saveRDS(model_info, file = file.path(output_dir, paste0("model_form_k6_combo", combo_num, ".rds")))

    successful_combos[[combo_num]] <- model_info
    message("Saved combo #", combo_num, ": ", paste(combo, collapse = ", "))
  }

  if (length(successful_combos) == max_needed) {
    message("Reached 100 valid combos.")
    break
  }
}

# Step 6: Save pairwise correlation log
write.csv(correlation_log, file = file.path(output_dir, "pairwise_covariate_correlations_k6.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
blood_row_summary <- t(apply(blood_by_brain_cor, 1, function(x) { #apply(df, 1=row, function)

## CALCULATE THE MEAN MEDIAN etc. for each COLUMN aka BRAIN genes

  quant <- quantile(x, probs = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.8, 0.9, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
  mn <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  c(
    Min = quant[1],
    `1st Qu.` = quant[2],
    Median = quant[3],
    Mean = mn,
    `3rd Qu.` = quant[4],
    `80th` = quant[5],
    `90th` = quant[6],
    Max = quant[7]
  )
}))
```

## DISSECT Correlations for FULL BRAIN
Examine correlational behaviors

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
############ BASELINE BLOOD AND FULL BRAIN ###############
##########################################################
## ask Klaren to send a list of IDs --> consent 
#InsertSizeMetrics_WIDTH_OF_80_PERCENT_blood look at one weird sample 
RNASeqMetrics_PCT_INTRONIC_BASES_blood

# residualize, pca, cor, repeat
form1 <- ~ (1|IID_ISMMS)
form2 <- ~ (1|IID_ISMMS) + mymet_rin_blood
form3 <- ~ (1|IID_ISMMS) + mymet_rin_blood + STAR_Insertion_average_length_blood

form4 <- ~ (1|IID_ISMMS) + mymet_rin_blood + STAR_Insertion_average_length_blood + Lymphocyte_total_wilk_blood
form5 <- ~ (1|IID_ISMMS) + mymet_rin_blood + STAR_Insertion_average_length_blood + Lymphocyte_total_wilk_blood + RNASeqMetrics_PCT_CODING_BASES_blood

form6 <- ~ (1|IID_ISMMS) + mymet_rin_blood + STAR_Insertion_average_length_blood + Lymphocyte_total_wilk_blood + RNASeqMetrics_PCT_CODING_BASES_blood + RNASeqMetrics_PCT_INTRONIC_BASES_blood
fit_blood <- dream(v_blood$E, form6, blood_metadata)
resid_expr_blood <- residuals(fit_blood)
write.table(resid_expr_blood, file = "/sc/arion/projects/mscic1/results/jolie/LBP/blood-brain/resid_expr_blood_form6.txt", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, col.names = NA)

# run canCorAllAgainstAll_Original() and plot_pca_by_metadata()

pca_blood <- prcomp(t(resid_expr_blood), center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
#resid_expr_blood_resid_ID_rin <- resid_expr_blood
#write.table(resid_expr_blood_resid_ID_rin, file = "/sc/arion/projects/mscic1/results/jolie/LBP/blood-brain/resid_expr_blood_resid_ID_rin_20250522.txt", sep = "\t", row.names = TRUE)

### BLOOD
blood_only_metadata <- blood_metadata[, grepl("_blood$", names(blood_metadata))]
pca = pca_blood
resCor=canCorAllAgainstAll_Original(blood_only_metadata,as.data.frame(pca$x[,1:10]),minimum_intersect=100)
ordered_resCor=do.call(order,as.data.frame(-resCor[,1:10]))
resCor=resCor[ordered_resCor,]
blood_only_metadata = blood_only_metadata[,rownames(resCor)] #columns of blood_metadata2 is in the same order as rownames(resCor), which is descending corr order
#head(resCor,100)
info_all2 <- blood_only_metadata
summ=summary(pca)
SampleByVariable = t(v_blood$E)
clonename<-rownames(SampleByVariable)

plot_pca_by_metadata(pca_blood, summary(pca_blood), info_all2, clonename,
                     file_prefix = "blood", form_label = "form5")
```

## CREATE DISTRIBUTION OF SUMMARY STATS OF CORRELATIONS 
k=2 and k=3
```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
library(biomaRt)
library(dplyr)
library(edgeR)
library(limma)
library(variancePartition)
library(matrixStats)
library(purrr)
library(caret)

set.seed(2025)
cd /sc/arion/projects/mscic1/results/jolie/LBP/blood-brain/qc/
ls -1 *resid_expr_blood_k2* 2>/dev/null | wc -l #103 files 

#correlations <- read.csv("/sc/arion/projects/mscic1/results/jolie/LBP/blood-brain/qc/pairwise_covariate_correlations.csv")
#model <- readRDS("/sc/arion/projects/mscic1/results/jolie/LBP/blood-brain/qc/model_form_k3_combo90.rds")

v_brain$E #21356   225

## ONE 
combo90 <- fread("/sc/arion/projects/mscic1/results/jolie/LBP/blood-brain/qc/resid_expr_blood_k2_combo90.txt", data.table = FALSE)
row.names(combo90) <- combo90$V1
combo90$V1 <- NULL
dim(combo90) #21046   225
cor_matrix <- cor(t(combo90), t(v_brain$E), method = "spearman")
#write.table(cor_matrix, file = "/sc/arion/projects/mscic1/results/jolie/LBP/blood-brain/blood_form6_brain_full_spearman_cor_matrix.txt", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = TRUE, col.names = NA)

## LOOP
blood_dir <- "/sc/arion/projects/mscic1/results/jolie/LBP/blood-brain/qc"
output_dir <- "/sc/arion/projects/mscic1/results/jolie/LBP/blood-brain/cor_results"  # adjust as needed
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Get blood files
blood_files <- list.files(blood_dir, pattern = "^resid_expr_blood_k2_combo[0-9]+\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)
blood_files <- blood_files[order(as.numeric(gsub("\\D", "", blood_files)))]

# Initialize summary stats storage
summary_stats <- data.frame(
  combo = integer(),
  mean_abs_cor = numeric(),
  median_abs_cor = numeric(),
  pct80_abs_cor = numeric(),
  pct90_abs_cor = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Start loop through each file
for (i in seq_along(blood_files)) {
  file_path <- blood_files[i]
  combo_number <- i
  
  # Progress message
  message(sprintf("Processing combo %d: %s", combo_number, basename(file_path)))
  
  # Read in blood expression matrix
  blood_expr <- fread(file_path, data.table = FALSE)
  rownames(blood_expr) <- blood_expr$V1
  blood_expr$V1 <- NULL
  
  # Compute Spearman correlation: genes x genes (across samples)
  cor_matrix <- cor(t(blood_expr), t(v_brain$E), method = "spearman")
  abs_cor <- abs(as.matrix(cor_matrix))
  
  # Save correlation matrix to .rds file
  cor_output_path <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("cor_matrix_combo", combo_number, ".rds"))
  saveRDS(abs_cor, cor_output_path)
  message(sprintf("Saved correlation matrix to: %s", cor_output_path))
  
  # Compute summary statistics of absolute correlations
  mean_val <- mean(abs_cor)
  median_val <- median(abs_cor)
  pct80_val <- quantile(abs_cor, probs = 0.8)
  pct90_val <- quantile(abs_cor, probs = 0.9)
  
  # Save stats to summary table
  summary_stats[combo_number, ] <- list(
    combo = combo_number,
    mean_abs_cor = mean_val,
    median_abs_cor = median_val,
    pct80_abs_cor = pct80_val,
    pct90_abs_cor = pct90_val
  )
  
  message(sprintf("Combo %d summary: mean = %.4f, median = %.4f", combo_number, mean_val, median_val))
}

#Combo 1 summary: mean = 0.0543, median = 0.0456
#Combo 2 summary: mean = 0.0574, median = 0.0490
#Combo 3 summary: mean = 0.0530, median = 0.0439

# Save summary statistics to CSV
summary_output_path <- file.path(output_dir, "blood_brain_correlation_summary.csv")
write.csv(summary_stats, summary_output_path, row.names = FALSE)
message(sprintf("All summary statistics saved to: %s", summary_output_path))

## K=3

test <- fread("/sc/arion/projects/mscic1/results/jolie/LBP/blood-brain/qc/resid_expr_blood_k3_combo90.txt", data.table = FALSE)
```

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
  fit_cv <- train(BrainExpr ~ ., data = df, method = "lm", trControl = train_control)

  # 2. Fit on entire data (training performance)
  full_model <- lm(BrainExpr ~ ., data = df)
  preds_train <- predict(full_model, newdata = df)
  r2_train <- cor(df$BrainExpr, preds_train)^2  # training R²

  tibble(
    gene = gene,
    r2_cv = fit_cv$results$Rsquared,     # CV (test) performance
    r2_train = r2_train                  # Training performance
  )
})

#### EXPLICITLY SPLIT TRAIN AND TEST FIRST - 07/15/2025
startt

library(caret)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)

set.seed(123)  # for reproducibility

model_results_cv <- map_dfr(1:ncol(brain_expr_t), function(i) {
  if (i %% 100 == 0) message("Processing gene ", i, " of ", ncol(brain_expr_t))
  
  gene <- colnames(brain_expr_t)[i]
  
  # Combine PCs with target gene expression, drop SampleID
  df <- cbind(pc_df[, setdiff(names(pc_df), "SampleID")], BrainExpr = brain_expr_t[, i])

  # Split 80% training, 20% testing
  n <- nrow(df)
  train_idx <- sample(1:n, floor(0.8 * n))
  test_idx <- setdiff(1:n, train_idx)
  
  df_train <- df[train_idx, ]
  df_test  <- df[test_idx, ]
  
  # 5-fold CV on training set
  train_control <- trainControl(method = "cv", number = 5)
  fit_cv <- train(BrainExpr ~ ., data = df_train, method = "lm", trControl = train_control)
  
  # Predict on test set
  preds_test <- predict(fit_cv, newdata = df_test)
  r2_test <- if (sd(preds_test) == 0 || sd(df_test$BrainExpr) == 0) NA else cor(preds_test, df_test$BrainExpr)^2
  
  # Return full caret CV results along with gene name and test R²
  tibble(
    gene = gene,
    intercept = fit_cv$results$Intercept,
    RMSE = fit_cv$results$RMSE,
    Rsquared = fit_cv$results$Rsquared,
    MAE = fit_cv$results$MAE,
    RMSESD = fit_cv$results$RMSESD,
    RsquaredSD = fit_cv$results$RsquaredSD,
    MAESD = fit_cv$results$MAESD,
    r2_test = r2_test
  )
})

##################################################
#################### ELASTIC NET #################
##################################################
# Load required packages
library(glmnet)   # for elastic net
library(furrr)    # for parallelized map
library(tibble)   # for tibble output
library(purrr)    # for map functions

# Transpose gene expression matrices so samples are rows
blood_expr_t <- t(v_blood$E)   # 225 samples x 21046 blood genes
brain_expr_t <- t(v_brain$E)   # 225 samples x 21356 brain genes

# Set up parallel backend
plan(multisession, workers = 15)  # Adjust based on your machine

# Run elastic net models in parallel
set.seed(123)
model_results <- future_map_dfr(1:ncol(brain_expr_t), function(i) {
  if (i %% 100 == 0) message("Processing brain gene ", i, " of ", ncol(brain_expr_t))

  y <- brain_expr_t[, i]
  x <- blood_expr_t

  # Cross-validated elastic net (alpha = 0.5)
  cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(x, y, alpha = 0.5, nfolds = 5)
  best_lambda <- cv_fit$lambda.min

  preds <- predict(cv_fit, s = best_lambda, newx = x)

  # R² computation: keep NA if variance is zero
  r2 <- if (sd(y) == 0 || sd(preds) == 0) NA else cor(y, preds)^2

  tibble(
    brain_gene = colnames(brain_expr_t)[i],
    best_lambda = best_lambda,
    r2 = r2
  )
}, .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE))

write.table(model_results, file = "/sc/arion/projects/mscic1/results/jolie/LBP/blood-brain/qc2/elastic_net_results_brain_predicted_from_blood.txt", sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

# Save full model objects in case you want to predict later
model_objects <- future_map(1:ncol(brain_expr_t), function(i) {
  y <- brain_expr_t[, i]
  x <- blood_expr_t

  # Return fitted model
  cv.glmnet(x, y, alpha = 0.5, nfolds = 5)
}, .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE))

saveRDS(model_objects, file = "/sc/arion/projects/mscic1/results/jolie/LBP/blood-brain/qc2/elastic_net_model_objects_all_brain_genes.rds")
```

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
  gene_info_blood$gene_biotype == "lncRNA" ~ "lncRNA",
  gene_info_blood$gene_biotype %in% c(
    "miRNA", "misc_RNA", "rRNA", "snoRNA", "snRNA", "vault_RNA", 
    "scaRNA", "sRNA", "ribozyme"
  ) ~ "ncRNA",
  gene_info_blood$gene_biotype %in% c(
    "processed_pseudogene", "transcribed_processed_pseudogene",
    "transcribed_unitary_pseudogene", "transcribed_unprocessed_pseudogene",
    "unitary_pseudogene", "unprocessed_pseudogene", "rRNA_pseudogene",
    "IG_C_pseudogene", "IG_J_pseudogene", "IG_V_pseudogene",
    "TR_J_pseudogene", "TR_V_pseudogene"
  ) ~ "Pseudogene",
  gene_info_blood$gene_biotype %in% c("Mt_rRNA", "Mt_tRNA") ~ "Mitochondrial RNA",
  gene_info_blood$gene_biotype %in% c(
    "IG_C_gene", "IG_J_gene", "IG_V_gene",
    "TR_C_gene", "TR_D_gene", "TR_J_gene", "TR_V_gene"
  ) ~ "Immune-Related",
  TRUE ~ "Artifact/Other" #Includes artifacts and TEC (To be Experimentally Confirmed)
)
```

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
  return(df)

# Step 1: Get NA counts
na_counts <- all_results %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  summarise(
    na_r2_train = sum(is.na(r2_train)),
    na_r2_test = sum(is.na(r2_test)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(model_label = paste0(model, " (NA train: ", na_r2_train, ", NA test: ", na_r2_test, ")"))

# Step 2: Merge back to all_results
all_results <- all_results %>%
  left_join(na_counts, by = "model") %>%
  mutate(model = model_label)  # overwrite with label containing NA info

summary_stats <- all_results %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  summarise(
    min_r2_train = min(r2_train, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25_r2_train = quantile(r2_train, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_r2_train = median(r2_train, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_r2_train = mean(r2_train, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75_r2_train = quantile(r2_train, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_r2_train = max(r2_train, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_r2_test = min(r2_test, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25_r2_test = quantile(r2_test, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_r2_test = median(r2_test, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_r2_test = mean(r2_test, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75_r2_test = quantile(r2_test, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_r2_test = max(r2_test, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

########### COMPUTING THE GENE-WISE CORRELATION ###################### 
# Gene-wise correlation refers to the correlation of expression values for a specific gene, gene A, 
#across samples between two conditions or  tissues (e.g., blood and brain).

#Identifies which genes are preserved across tissues.
#Each gene has its own gene-wise correlation across samples.

# Step 1: Get gene names from row and column
blood_genes <- rownames(blood_form3_by_brain_cor)
brain_genes <- colnames(blood_form3_by_brain_cor)

# Step 2: Find genes common to both blood and brain
common_genes <- intersect(blood_genes, brain_genes) #17533

#21046 - 17533 = 3513 blood only
#21356 - 17533 = 3823 brain only

# Step 3: Subset to just those matching genes
# For each gene in common_genes, grab the correlation with itself
genewise_cor <- sapply(common_genes, function(gene) {
  blood_form3_by_brain_cor[gene, gene]
})

# Step 4: Convert to a dataframe for plotting
genewise_cor_df <- data.frame(
  gene = names(genewise_cor),
  correlation = genewise_cor
)

#blood_form3_brain_baseline_spearman_cor_matrix.txt
summary(genewise_cor_df$correlation)

# Step 5: Plot the distribution
library(ggplot2)
plot <- ggplot(genewise_cor_df, aes(x = correlation)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Gene-wise blood-brain correlation form 3 with residID base brain",
       x = "Correlation (same gene in blood vs brain)",
       y = "Count") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14)
  )
```
